guitar.evidence: Scott Ian is well known for Jackson rhythm guitars (and later signature models); Dan Spitz used Kramer/Charvel-style guitars in the 80s. Original is a fair generalization.
guitar.notes: Kept as-is; brand mix is plausible across the band's history.
